apps.title: Ares apps
apps.lead: Native SwiftUI apps for the iPhone: personal finance, flat hunting, a knowledge vault and server monitoring. Each one speaks English and German, comes in light and dark, and shares one account with the others.
apps.state: Built and tested. Available via TestFlight as soon as Apple approves the developer account; anyone is welcome to try them and request features.
apps.requestNote: Access is by request: each one is approved personally and answered with a TestFlight invite.
